# betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_group (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_group" "example" {
  process_id             = betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_process.example.id
  work_item_type_id      = betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_workitemtype.example.reference_name
  page_id                = betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_page.example.id
  section_id             = "Section1"
  label                  = "My Custom Group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Label for the group.
- `page_id` (String) The ID of the page to add the group to.
- `process_id` (String) The ID of the process.
- `section_id` (String) The ID of the section to add the group to.
- `work_item_type_reference_name` (String) The reference name of the work item type.

### Optional

- `control` (Block List) Controls to be created with the group. Required for HTML controls which cannot be added to existing groups. This is mutally exclusive with the 'betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_control' resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--control))
- `order` (Number) Order in which the group should appear in the section.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `visible` (Boolean) A value indicating if the group should be hidden or not.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--control"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the control. This is the field reference name (e.g., System.Description).

Optional:

- `contribution` (Block List, Max: 1) Contribution for the control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--control--contribution))
- `is_contribution` (Boolean) A value indicating if the control is a contribution (extension) control.
- `label` (String) Label for the control.
- `metadata` (String) Inner text of the control.
- `read_only` (Boolean) A value indicating if the control is read only.
- `visible` (Boolean) A value indicating if the control should be hidden or not.
- `watermark` (String) Watermark text for the textbox.

Read-Only:

- `control_type` (String) Type of the control (e.g., HtmlFieldControl, FieldControl).
- `inherited` (Boolean) A value indicating whether this control has been inherited from a parent layout.
- `order` (Number) Order in which the control appears in the group. Determined by the position in the control list.
- `overridden` (Boolean) A value indicating whether this control has been overridden by a child layout.

<a id="nestedblock--control--contribution"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control.contribution`

Required:

- `contribution_id` (String) The id for the contribution.

Optional:

- `height` (Number) The height for the contribution.
- `inputs` (Map of String) A dictionary holding key value pairs for contribution inputs.
- `show_on_deleted_work_item` (Boolean) A value indicating if the contribution should be shown on deleted work item.
